ai_summary: Alkem Laboratories has announced the launch of Renocia Exo™, India's first patented Ginsenoside Exosome-based hair growth serum, signifying a strategic entry into the rapidly growing hair loss management market with an innovative, next-generation product. This move strengthens Alkem's dermatology portfolio and positions the company as a scientific innovator in addressing a prevalent dermatological concern through a multi-targeted approach. A notable red flag is the document's future date of September 8, 2026, which is a curious inconsistency.
